description: JSON schema for Aurora architectural model cards

$schema.description: The schema file this card adheres to

boundary.description: Optional grouping label for rendering and organization

attributes.description: Key-value pairs providing additional data for tooling and agents

card_subtype.description: An optional refinement of the card_type in Title Case

card_type.description: The architectural type represented by the card in Title Case

description.description: Details regarding the element the card represents

id.description: A stable identifier composed of a 3-letter prefix and a numeric suffix (e.g., 'MIS-001')

links.description: Relationships between cards, always directed away from mission

relationship.description: A verb-based description of the relationship (view-dependent)

name.description: A concise human-readable name for the card

notes.description: Additional notes and information attached to the card

version.description: Semantic version of the card meaning (major.minor.patch)

title: Aurora Card Schema
